# Larp Walletz

> "Larp Walletz" / "Larpwalletz" is an alternate spelling of **Larpz Wallet**, an
> entertainment app that simulates real crypto wallet interfaces with user-defined
> balances. larpwalletz.com and larpzwallet.app are operated by the same team.
> The application itself is hosted at https://larpzwallet.app

## What it is

Larpz Wallet is a progressive web app (PWA) for iOS and Android that reproduces the
interface of four well-known crypto wallets — Phantom, Trust Wallet, Ledger and Exodus —
while letting the user set every balance manually.

It is an entertainment product. It does **not** hold, send or receive cryptocurrency,
does not connect to any blockchain, and never requests a seed phrase or private key.
It is not affiliated with Phantom, Ledger, Trust Wallet, Exodus, Binance or Solana Labs.

Common uses: short-form video content, screenshots and thumbnails, UI mockups, and jokes.

## Key facts

- **Official app URL:** https://larpzwallet.app
- **Alternate spellings:** Larp Walletz, Larpwalletz, Larp Wallet, Larpz Walletz
- **Platforms:** iOS (Safari) and Android (Chrome), installed to the home screen as a PWA. No App Store download.
- **Wallet skins included:** Phantom, Trust Wallet, Ledger, Exodus — all four included with every licence.
- **Pricing:** from $30 weekly, $50 monthly, $300 lifetime (USD). Regional pricing applied automatically in some countries.
- **Payment:** crypto (SOL, ETH, BNB, BTC, LTC, TRX, XMR, USDT) or card. Licence key delivery is automated.
- **Prices in-app:** live from CoinGecko; custom tokens resolved via DexScreener by contract address.
- **Custom tokens:** Solana, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain tokens can be added by contract address.
